name: arabic-carousel
description: Arabic design studio for social media: single posts, carousels and 9:16 reels in RTL Arabic. Claude plans, writes and draws; the studio lays out independent editable elements, reflows content without unreadable text, checks every word, and delivers an offline editor (PNG, ZIP, PDF, video) or a Canva design. It reuses the creator's design library, assets and saved taste before generating anything new.
